name: HB-2 x2 detached full-util launch
purpose: Further accelerate the HB-2 external full-grid run by using two shard processes per GPU on GPUs 0-3, adding a detached/nohup launcher so the run survives VS Code terminal lifecycle events, validating the detached path on a low-budget dry run, and launching the formal x2 run. This is a launch/progress item and draws no HB-2 conclusion.

provenance.formal_launch_command: RUN_ROOT=results/kvcache_matched_budget_v0/hb2_external_runs/gpu0_3_x2_batched_formal BASELINES=lfs,tot_rap,best_of_n SHARDS=8 GPUS=4 INSTANCES=64 TASKS=sudoku,futoshiki,graph_color BUDGET_SCALES=0.25,0.5,1,2,4 SAMPLE_BATCH_SIZE=32 VALUE_BATCH_SIZE=8 scripts/launch_hb2_external_full_grid_detached.sh
provenance.gpu_policy: Use GPUs 0-3 with two model processes per GPU; leave GPUs 4-7 to the independent UI-S1/PO process.

commands.purpose: Launch formal HB-2 external full-grid run with x2 GPU0-3 utilization.

headline.detached: Detached dry run completed best-of-n, LFS, and ToT/RAP with merged outputs and no errors.
headline.utilization: Formal x2 run shows GPUs 0-3 at about 32GB each and 98-99% utilization during LFS startup.
headline.isolation: GPUs 4-7 remain assigned to the independent UI-S1/PO process and are not used by HB-2.
headline.formal_launch: Formal x2 run is detached under master pid 1017341 with logs in results/kvcache_matched_budget_v0/hb2_external_runs/gpu0_3_x2_batched_formal/master.log.

gate_outcomes.number: Dry run produced all three merged outputs under debug_detached_x2.
Formal run mapped 8 LFS python processes across GPUs 0-3 with approximately 98-99% utilization.
Formal x2 roots use full_grid_n64_gpu0_3_x2_batched and are separate from cancelled 4-shard/8-shard roots.
No merged formal full-grid result exists yet; no scientific conclusion is drawn.

decision.next_step_routing: Monitor detached pid/log and checkpoint rows. Create HB-2 closeout/read only after formal x2 merged outputs exist.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not contain HB-2 results and does not compare solve rates. It records only launch engineering and utilization evidence.
honesty.scope_limit: Two processes per GPU improves utilization by concurrency, not by changing the LFS control loop. Token accounting and official scoring remain unchanged.
honesty.conclusion_policy: Do not use debug_detached_x2 or cancelled roots for HB-2 final results; only formal x2 merged outputs are eligible.
honesty.external_process_note: The independent UI-S1/PO process on GPUs 4-7 is left untouched by the HB-2 launcher.
